newsitem.title: COMOROS: Comoros government orders strikers back to work.
newsitem.headline: Comoros government orders strikers back to work.

text.p: The government of the Indian Ocean Comoro islands has ordered striking teachers and hospital workers back to work on Thursday, saying those who fail to return will lose their jobs.
The ministers of health and education in a statement on Tuesday night said anyone who was not back at work on Thursday would be considered to have resigned and would be replaced.
Teachers and hospital staff have been on strike since the start of the year, initially demanding payment of 10 months of salaries owed by the government.
In January, the strikers dropped their demand to only the payment of one month of arrears but the government says it cannot afford to pay even that.

President Mohamed Taki's government blames its failure to pay civil servants on the disastrous state of public finances. Comoros has had up to 17 attempted coups since independence from France in 1975.
